summary_1line: Vishwamitra forces a sacrifice for Trishanku, sends him bodily to heaven, and when the gods reject him, creates a new heaven where Trishanku hangs suspended.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Trishanku rises bodily toward the sky during the sacrifice as astonished sages watch the miracle.
Rejected by Indra, Trishanku falls headlong from heaven while crying out to Vishwamitra for protection.
In fury, Vishwamitra stands among sages creating new stars and a separate heaven with Trishanku suspended upside down in the sky.
